meta.source: Reserve Bank of India (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Policy rates and auction results are final when announced. The Handbook restates a few effective dates between editions (newest edition wins, differences listed in rates-policy meta). Lending and deposit rates: each monthly release repeats the full history; the newest release wins.
meta.coverage: The Mumbai interbank offer and bid rates (MIBOR, MIBID) for overnight, 14-day, 1-month and 3-month money, daily since June 1998
meta.note: RBI, Mumbai Inter-Bank Offer Rate (MIBOR) and Mumbai Inter-Bank Bid Rate (MIBID) (DBIE report 993). Polled by NSE until 2015 and computed by FBIL from 2015 (the overnight MIBOR from actual call trades); the RBI's table does not mark the change. MIBID was discontinued; the standard-deviation rows the table also prints are not baked.
